title: Tech news today, 26 November 2026

items.headline: MC1568439: Out-of-band hotpatch update addresses stop error 0x139 on Windows Server 2025
items.summary: Microsoft has released a new Windows out-of-band (OOB) update today, November 25, 2026, to address an issue affecting a limited number of Windows Servers with Router Advertisement (RA) enabled that receive time-bound IPv6 routes. Affected devices might stop unexpectedly with stop error 0x139 (KERNEL_SECURITY_CHECK_FAILURE) when a route timer expires. This issue affects some Windows Server 2025 devices after installing the November 2026 Windows security hotpatch update. This non-security OOB upda...
lines: Microsoft released an out-of-band Windows update on November 25, 2026, to address stop error 0x139 (KERNEL_SECURITY_CHECK_FAILURE) on Windows Servers.

The issue affects a limited number of Windows Servers with Router Advertisement (RA) enabled that receive time-bound IPv6 routes, and devices may stop when a route timer expires. The text says it can also affect some Windows Server 2025 devices after the November 2026 security hotpatch.
IT teams running Windows Server 2025 with RA enabled and time-bound IPv6 routes may need to review this non-security update.

items.headline: Rooms "More actions" Panel Reordering
items.summary: Starting on December 02, 2026, we are updating the order of options within the "More actions" panel on Google Meet hardware touch controllers. This update introduces improvements based on usage patterns and user feedback, prioritizing high-frequency actions so room participants can access essential controls faster and with less scrolling. Key adjustments in the panel include: Moving frequently used controls such as Present, Adjust view , and People higher in the menu for direct access from the side panel on most touch controllers. Retaining primary in-room actions, including Chat at the top and Control camera near the front of the list, while demoting lower-frequency tools like Recording or
lines: Google is reordering options in the "More actions" panel on Google Meet hardware touch controllers, moving frequently used controls such as Present, Adjust view, and People higher in the menu.
The change starts on December 02, 2026.
Based on usage patterns and user feedback, the change aims to let room participants reach common controls faster and with less scrolling.

items.headline: Retirement: Support for Java 8, 11 and 17 in Azure Functions ends on September 1, 2027
items.summary: Support for Java 8, 11 and 17 on Azure Functions is ending on September 1, 2027. Your apps that are hosted on Azure Functions will continue to run, but security updates will no longer be available, and we’ll no longer provide customer service for Java 8,

items.headline: Cisco UCS and UCS-Based Appliances UEFI Shell Secure Boot Bypass Vulnerability
items.summary: A vulnerability in the Unified Extensible Firmware Interface (UEFI) Shell implementation of Cisco UCS Servers and UCS-based appliances could allow an authenticated attacker with valid credentials for a user account with the role of user or admin or an unauthenticated attacker with physical access to an affected device to bypass UEFI Secure Boot validation checks and execute unauthorized software. This vulnerability is due to the availability of memory write commands in the UEFI Shell while UEFI Secure Boot is enabled on a device. An attacker could exploit this vulnerability by selecting the UEFI Shell boot option at boot time and using available shell commands to modify UEFI memory variables
lines: A vulnerability in the UEFI Shell of Cisco UCS Servers and UCS-based appliances can let an attacker bypass UEFI Secure Boot validation checks and execute unauthorized software.

An authenticated attacker with user or admin credentials, or an unauthenticated attacker with physical access, could exploit it by selecting the UEFI Shell boot option at boot time and using shell commands to modify UEFI memory variables.
IT teams managing Cisco UCS servers may want to review the advisory, since the flaw affects the boot protection that Secure Boot provides.

items.headline: MC1568568: Configure security key sign-in experience for display-based NFC readers
items.summary: What and why: An improved security key sign-in experience is available on Windows 11 devices with display-based Near Field Communication (NFC) readers. A new on-screen indicator now shows where to tap your security key during sign-in. The indicator adjusts to the device's screen orientation, making it easier to locate the NFC reader. Rollout schedule:This improved sign-in experience and simpler appearance are available starting with the November 2026 Windows non-security update. Impact on your o...
lines: Windows 11 devices with display-based Near Field Communication (NFC) readers now show an on-screen indicator for where to tap a security key during sign-in.
The indicator adjusts to screen orientation and is available starting with the November 2026 Windows non-security update.
The change may make security key sign-in easier to complete on devices with NFC readers, according to the text's description of a simpler appearance.

lines: Microsoft Teams will expand Markdown support in the compose box, with visible syntax, a Markdown toolbar, message preview, and switching between Markdown and rich text.

items.headline: Amazon EC2 M8g instances are now available in Israel (Tel Aviv)
items.summary: Starting today, Amazon Elastic Compute Cloud (Amazon EC2) M8g instances are available in the Israel (Tel Aviv) region. These instances are powered by AWS Graviton4 processors and deliver up to 30% better performance compared to AWS Graviton3-based instances. Amazon EC2 M8g instances are built for general-purpose workloads, such as application servers, microservices, gaming servers, midsize data stores, and caching fleets. M8g instances are up to 40% faster for databases, up to 30% faster for web applications, and up to 45% faster for large Java applications than AWS Graviton3-based M7g instances. These instances are built on the AWS Nitro System , which offloads CPU virtualization, storage,
lines: Amazon EC2 M8g instances are now available in the Israel (Tel Aviv) region, powered by AWS Graviton4 processors.
AWS says the instances deliver up to 30% better performance than Graviton3-based instances and are built for general-purpose workloads such as application servers, microservices, and caching fleets.
The text cites up to 40% faster databases and up to 45% faster large Java applications than M7g instances, which may matter to IT teams sizing these workloads.

items.headline: AWS Lambda now supports orchestrating MicroVMs with Lambda durable functions
items.summary: Today, AWS announces a developer preview of a new extension for orchestrating Lambda MicroVMs with Lambda durable functions . The extension adds durable operations for running work on MicroVMs and managing their lifecycle. You can use the new operations to build software factories, security scanners, or orchestrate CI/CD jobs that run untrusted or agent-generated code in isolated sandboxes. With Lambda durable functions, you can build resilient, multi-step applications and AI workflows that run for up to one year, with built-in checkpointing and automatic retries. Lambda MicroVMs are a serverless compute primitive that provides VM-level isolation, near-instant launch and resume, and state pr
lines: AWS announced a developer preview of an extension for orchestrating Lambda MicroVMs with Lambda durable functions. It adds durable operations for running work on MicroVMs and managing their lifecycle.
The extension is in developer preview.
IT teams can use it to orchestrate CI/CD jobs and security scanners that run untrusted or agent-generated code in isolated sandboxes.

"In the versions we analyzed, building or running a

items.headline: MC1568700: Microsoft 365 Copilot: Customize how citations are included when copying responses

lines: Microsoft 365 Copilot will add a customizable "Copy with sources" option, letting users choose whether to include citations when copying responses.
The option is enabled by default and can be turned off to copy text without citations. Rollout is scheduled by mid-December 2026.
Users can control whether citations come along when they copy Copilot responses. No admin action is needed.

lines: SharePoint is introducing site campaigns, which integrate Viva Amplify campaign management directly into SharePoint.
Rollout begins mid-August 2026 and is available to both seeded and licensed Viva Amplify users.
Teams can create, distribute and analyze news post campaigns within SharePoint. Existing Amplify campaigns and licensing are unchanged.

The campaign uses paid ads to direct users to install malicious browser extensions that steal browser cookies, collect Meta Business data, read emails and, in some cases, delete security alerts. Key findings: * Ongoing attack: Bitdefender Labs identified the first malicious SYS010 advertisement on October 16, 2026. * A new generatio
lines: Bitdefender Labs uncovered SYS010, a new malvertising campaign that uses Meta ads promoting free animated wallpaper apps to target Meta Business accounts.
The campaign directs users to install malicious browser extensions that steal browser cookies, collect Meta Business data, read emails and, in some cases, delete security alerts.
Bitdefender Labs identified the first malicious SYS010 advertisement on October 16, 2026. IT teams may want to review browser extensions and Meta Business account activity.

The vivo X500 series is available for pre-order through vivo's official online store and Flipkart, with open sales scheduled to begin on December 3. As for pricing, the vivo X500 starts at INR 1,19,999 for the 12GB/256GB variant. The X500 Pro is priced at INR 1,49,999 for the same memory configuration, while the X500 Pro Max starts at INR 1,64,999. The X500 Pro Max...
lines: Reported by GSMArena news: Nearly two months after its China debut, the vivo X500 series launched in India with the base X500, X500 Pro and X500 Pro Max.
The series is available for pre-order through vivo's official online store and Flipkart, with open sales scheduled to begin on December 3.
The X500 starts at INR 1,19,999 for the 12GB/256GB variant, the X500 Pro is priced at INR 1,49,999 for the same memory configuration, and the X500 Pro Max starts at INR 1,64,999.

lines: Reported by MediaNama: Persistent Systems disclosed a possible data breach at a US law firm that handles employee immigration records.
Open questions include the scale of the leak, whether employees will be notified and how regulatory compliance applies.
HR and IT teams may need to plan for breach scope and notification questions that remain unanswered.

Some kits manage that far more often than others, and those are the kits that security teams need to know about. lines: Reported by The Hacker News: Push Security describes phishing kits that get past email security, web filtering and safe browsing, and says some kits do this more often than others.
Push Security defines breakthrough rate as the share of attacks that get past email security, web gateways and safe browsing to reach the user.
Security teams can use breakthrough rate to compare which phishing kits are most likely to reach employees.

items.headline: SYS010 malware abuses browser management to spy on Gmail, Outlook
items.summary: A new version of the SYS01 infostealer malware delivered through Meta ads is enrolling browsers into enterprise-style management to force the installation of an extension that steals sensitive data, including Gmail and Outlook emails. [...]
lines: Reported by BleepingComputer: A new version of the SYS01 infostealer, delivered through Meta ads, enrolls browsers into enterprise-style management.
The management enrollment is used to force installation of an extension that steals sensitive data, including Gmail and Outlook emails.
IT teams may want to review how browser management policies are configured on endpoints.

items.summary: Monetization of personal data is against public policy at large and works against the letter and spirit of the law in myriad ways that ultimately defeat the purpose of the law itself, the author argues. The post Views: Can monetization of personal data amount to a breach under India’s data protection law? appeared first on MEDIANAMA .
lines: Reported by MediaNama: an author argues that monetization of personal data is against public policy and works against the letter and spirit of India's data protection law.
The author argues that such monetization defeats the purpose of the law itself.
Business users who handle personal data may find the question of whether monetization counts as a breach relevant to compliance planning.

items.headline: Drupal Warns of New Highly Critical Site Takeover Vulnerability Under Active Exploitation
items.summary: Drupal has warned of a new "highly critical" security flaw impacting Drupal core that it said has been exploited in the wild. The vulnerability, tracked as CVE-2026-136716 (CVSS score: N/A), has been described as a case of improper checking for unusual or exceptional conditions. It also relates to CVE-2026-132165 aka Fail2Install in that it addresses remaining vulnerable installation states
lines: Reported by The Hacker News: Drupal warned of a new 'highly critical' site takeover vulnerability in Drupal core that it said has been exploited in the wild.
The flaw is tracked as CVE-2026-136716, has no CVSS score listed, and is described as improper checking for unusual or exceptional conditions.
It relates to CVE-2026-132165 (Fail2Install) in that it addresses remaining vulnerable installation states. Drupal site operators may want to check their core versions against the vendor advisory.

items.headline: Remus malware steals Gmail messages via fake Google Sheets extension

The malware operators marketed this capability as a zero-day exploit in Google's email service.
IT teams may want to review installed Chrome extensions, especially those posing as Google Sheets tools.

lines: Reported by The Hacker News: The North Korea-linked PolinRider campaign has poisoned over 7,600 GitHub repositories to spread malware.
The threat actors planted a Python loader that hides in a small utils package or in conftest.py, and runs when Python imports the file.
